title: strjust
summary: Justify character rows left, right, or center.

gpu_support.notes: Justification is host text processing. Numeric and provider-resident inputs reject before provider access.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes host text or logical results.

description: `strjust(text, side)` repositions the non-space characters in each text row without changing its width. The optional side is `"left"`, `"right"`, or `"center"`.
behaviors: The default alignment is right; pass `"left"` or `"center"` to select another alignment.
Row width is preserved while leading and trailing spaces are redistributed.
Integer arrays are not character-code input and are not implicitly converted to text.
